column1: # Provisional game profile (written on Windows from dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# The SDK sizes its heap as pool - used - 1 MB. The modules are 0x4E00000 (81.8 MB measured, bss 0), more than the 64 MB
# default, so the 0xC9400000 request came back LimitReached and the game fell back to a 32 MB heap: its NVN memory pools
# (64 + 64 + 128 MB) then had no storage and it crashed on the first null blend state (log of 2026-10-30:
# SetHeapSize 0xc9400000 + modules 0x4e00000 > app pool 0xcd500000, three [RED] MemoryPoolInitialize, sig=11 in
# h_nvnBlendStateSetDefaults). The rewritten modules rounded up to a 16 MB granule, as fill_mem_used() computes it.
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
